**Findings**

In [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2381), `HandleTurnEnd` now advances `CheckpointTranscriptStart` after any mid-turn commit if the transcript grew. If a mid-turn commit also carried files forward, the new stop-time code overwrites that `0` and breaks the invariant the surrounding comments already document.

2. Medium: the Copilot transcript-path comment is also valid. The new code in [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2387) calls `GetTranscriptPosition(state.TranscriptPath)` directly, but other transcript readers first re-resolve the path via [resolve_transcript.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/resolve_transcript.go#L23) to handle agents that relocate transcript files mid-session. If relocation happened, this new block can silently fail to advance the offset and reintroduce the original bug for those agents.

3. Low: the Copilot test cleanup comment is reasonable. [transcript_offset_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/transcript_offset_test.go#L159) computes `transcriptLinesAtCommit` and immediately discards it. It is dead code and the name is misleading because it is a byte length, not a transcript position.

**Summary**

Two comments identify real code issues; one is a cleanup nit. The carry-forward regression is the important one to fix before merge.

1. Medium: Codex `StartLine` semantics are now inconsistent with the stored checkpoint offset, so v2 compact transcripts can be scoped incorrectly. `CheckpointTranscriptStart` for Codex comes from `GetTranscriptPosition()`, which counts raw JSONL lines including `session_meta` and `event_msg` entries in [transcript.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/transcript.go#L77). But `compact.Compact()` now treats Codex `StartLine` as a `response_item` index in [compact.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/compact.go#L82) and [codex.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/codex.go#L79). The direct explain/summarize path is safe because it slices raw transcript bytes first, but the v2/migration path still passes the stored offset straight into `compact.Compact()` in [manual_commit_condensation.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_condensation.go#L1109) and [migrate.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/migrate.go#L425). On real Codex transcripts with token-count/event lines before the checkpoint boundary, this will include already-condensed content in `transcript.jsonl` or skip too much.

I didn’t find a second concrete bug in the rest of the patch. I ran the targeted Codex tests in `compact`, `summarize`, and `cli`; they all passed, but they currently encode the new `response_item`-based assumption, which is why this mismatch is still slipping through.

Yes, there is overlap, but it is semantic rather than file-level.

[`PR #873`](https://github.com/entireio/cli/pull/873) changes how `CheckpointTranscriptStart` is produced for mid-turn Codex commits. It updates the stored offset at turn end in [manual_commit_hooks.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/strategy/manual_commit_hooks.go#L2402) and adds integration coverage in [transcript_offset_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/transcript_offset_test.go#L121). That PR is clearly treating the offset as “current transcript position” from the Codex analyzer, which in practice is a raw JSONL line count from [agent/codex/transcript.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/agent/codex/transcript.go#L77).

The local `codex-explain-generate` branch touches different files, but it consumes the same field. In explain/summarize it uses raw line slicing, which is consistent. But in the compact/v2 path it now treats Codex `StartLine` as a `response_item` count in [transcript/compact/codex.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli_worktree1/cmd/entire/cli/transcript/compact/codex.go#L314), and that is where the semantic mismatch appears.

So the overlap is:

- `#873` defines and strengthens the meaning of `CheckpointTranscriptStart` for Codex as a raw transcript position.
- This local branch partly assumes the same field is a `response_item` index when building compact transcripts.

That means they are not duplicate fixes, but they do intersect on the same contract. If `#873` merges, it makes my review finding on this branch more important, not less.
